### Key Buying & Care Tips

- **Match gait and terrain** : According to [Road Runner Sports](https://google.com/goto?url=REDACTED) , neutral shoes fit a natural stride, while stability shoes help counter overpronation. Choose road shoes for pavement and lugged trail shoes for dirt or mud.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=REDACTED)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:6054662676242934870,catalogid:4963235765911137734,gpcid:15566446623960197492,mid:576462575785430501&ibp=oshop)
- **Check sizing**: [Fleet Feet](https://google.com/goto?url=REDACTED) recommends keeping about a thumb's width of space between your longest toe and the front of the shoe with a secure heel and midfoot fit.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=REDACTED)
- **Track mileage and care** : Replace most running shoes around **300 to 500 miles** as cushioning compresses, and let wet shoes air-dry away from direct high heat.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=REDACTED)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:5221427576781278536,catalogid:16033449681557150082,gpcid:7326703641027475137,mid:576462549196774912&ibp=oshop)

To narrow down the best options, share:

- **How you plan to use them** (daily easy runs, speedwork, long distances, trails, or walking)
- **Your support and fit needs** (neutral vs. stability, wide sizing, or men's vs. women's)
- **Your target budget**

references.title: Brooks Men's Ghost 18
references.text: The Ghost 18 is an all-rounder designed by Brooks for your daily run. With the Ghost 18, you have a perfect blend of comfort, support, and durability. Experience the ultimate performance of the Ghost 18, day after day. Midsole The Ghost 18 features Brooks' DNA LOFT v3 foam in the midsole. This foam is incredibly soft and has an innovative character compared to the previous version. Nitrogen has been incorporated into the cushioning material to optimize responsiveness and shock absorption. The foam features Brooks' DNA technology, whereby the foam adapts to your running style. As a result, the shoe features cushioning foam that ensures a smooth transition from heel to toe. Upperwork The Triple Jacquard Air Mesh upper consists of three layers of woven mesh that combine durability, support, and ventilation. Thanks to the open structure, the shoe remains lightweight and breathable, while the material molds snugly to the foot, contributing to a comfortable and supportive fit, even during intense runs. This shoe also features an OrthoLite X-60 insole. This insole offers soft step-in comfort and provides long-lasting cushioning. OrthoLite X-60 features open-cell foam that ensures the shoe is breathable on the inside and keeps your feet cool. Outsole The shoe features a RoadTack outsole, made from a mix of rubber and recycled silica. Additionally, this Brooks outsole technology is durable and resilient against compression, ensuring they last extra long. Order and discover the versatility of the Brooks Ghost 18 within days.
